title: Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion: SNR-Equalized Heat Flow for Graph Signals
abstract: arXiv:2609.39658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models generate data by reversing a forward corruption process that typically approaches a simple Gaussian prior. Recent work has extended this framework to signals supported on fixed graphs, e.g., road-network traffic and sensor-network measurements. Many graph signals have nonuniform spectral energy, whereas isotropic corruption adds the same conditional noise variance to every graph-frequency mode. Driving all modes to near-zero terminal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) requires strong corruption, which increases the noise range that must be covered under a fixed sampling budget. We introduce Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion (GRCD), which replaces the shared clock of graph heat diffusion with a mode-dependent clock that gives every graph-Fourier mode the same conditional SNR. translated_title: 图残差共轭扩散：面向图信号的信噪比均衡热流
translated_abstract: 扩散模型通过逆转一个前向破坏过程来生成数据，该过程通常趋近于一个简单的高斯先验。近期工作已将这一框架扩展到支撑于固定图上的信号，例如路网交通和传感器网络测量数据。许多图信号具有非均匀的谱能量，而各向同性的破坏会给每个图频率模态添加相同的条件噪声方差。若要将所有模态驱动至接近零的终端信噪比（SNR），则需要较强的破坏，这会增大在固定采样预算下必须覆盖的噪声范围。我们提出图残差共轭扩散（GRCD），用一个依赖模态的时钟取代图热扩散的共享时钟，使每个图傅里叶模态具有相同的条件信噪比。GRCD 在训练集上拟合一个零均值的图谱高斯参考分布，并停止于一个有限的终端信噪比，在该信噪比下传播后的参考分布仍然……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出图残差共轭扩散（GRCD），通过依赖模态的扩散时钟替代共享时钟，使每个图傅里叶模态获得相同的条件信噪比，从而在有限终端信噪比下高效实现图信号的扩散生成。
en_tdlr: Proposes Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion (GRCD), which replaces the shared diffusion clock with a mode-dependent clock so that every graph-Fourier mode has the same conditional SNR, enabling effective graph-signal generation at a finite terminal SNR.
